local function parse_time(t)
  local h, m = t:match('^(%d+):(%d+)$')
  return tonumber(h) * 60 + tonumber(m)
end

local function format_ts(date, minutes)
  local h = math.floor(minutes / 60)
  local m = minutes % 60
  return string.format('%sT%02d:%02d:00Z', date, h, m)
end

local possible_starts = {}

end

        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end

  for _, start_m in ipairs(possible_starts) do
    local end_m = start_m + 60
    local all_free = true
    for _, uid in ipairs(user_ids) do
      if not is_free(uid, start_m, end_m) then
        all_free = false
        break
      end
    end
    if all_free then
      return {
        start = format_ts(date, start_m),
        ['end'] = format_ts(date, end_m),
        users = user_ids
      }
    end
  end
end

return {error = 'no slot found', users = user_ids}
